product_summary: Ahmedabad (Vatva, Gujarat) maker/exporter of packaging and converting machinery, per own site sitemap (fusiontechinternational.com/sitemap.xml): soap wrapping/packing/binding/stamping/cutting machines, flow-wrapping and horizontal flow-wrap machines, over-wrapping machines, shrink-wrap tunnel, pouch-making machine, box packing and box/side taping machines, auger food packing machine, granules packing machine, blown film line, slitting-rewinding machine, trim winder, triple roll mill, bar coaters, plus components: industrial/printing/inking rubber rollers, anilox rollers, doctor blades (plastic), safety chucks, lug-type and multi-tube pneumatic air shafts, bow rollers, PVC/plastic cores.
comment: Declared 842240 (packing/wrapping machinery) is corroborated by the site's own product list (soap wrapping, flow-wrap, over-wrapping, shrink tunnel, pouch making, box taping) — partial match, not exact, because the catalogue spans several headings. Correct/complete code set: 842230 (filling/closing/capsuling machines — auger food and granules packing machines), 842240 (wrapping/packing — soap wrapping, flow-wrap, over-wrap, box packing), 847780 (machinery for working rubber/plastics — blown film line, pouch making), 847989 (slitting-rewinding, trim winder, triple roll mill, bar coaters), 844110/844190 (cutting and auxiliary printing machinery — doctor blades, anilox/inking rollers as printing-press parts), 848790 (safety chucks, air shafts, bow rollers — machinery parts), 392690 (PVC/plastic cores). Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: the company is a capital-goods machinery manufacturer, not a food/FMCG producer — food relevance is only that it builds auger/granules packing machines for food. Trader signs: none found; site presents itself as manufacturer and exporter (GST 24AMDPG8334Q1ZP shown on site, not independently verified here). All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this HS-only pass; no export/invoice evidence reviewed. No HS-based rejection: company retained, code corrected.
